newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks end down on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks end down on profit-taking.

text.p: Pakistani stocks ended down on Thursday as profit-taking in select blue chips by speculators offset early institutional support and buying interest, dealers said.
The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index fell 1.76 points, or 0.12 percent, to end at 1,411.99. Gainers led losers 130-104.

"Speculations about Pakistan's chances of getting the stalled tranche of IMF's standby loan pushed the index up," dealer Mudasar Malik said. "But this optimisim did not last long and people started booking profits. Glaxo Lab fell 2.0 to 80.
